[Patch] 两个修改，不依赖任何 pending 实验：

**#1. 主文 grammar "zero DR" 措辞修正**

当前 §5.5 或 §4 某处写 "grammar layer provides zero DR reduction"（基于 SciERC DR 1.5%→1.5%）。DocRED ZS 数据显示 grammar-only DR 反升（13.45%→17.03%）。

修改：将 "zero DR reduction" 改为更准确的表述：
"Grammar-only decoding provides no DR reduction on SciERC (1.50%→1.50%) and increases DR on DocRED (13.45%→17.03% zero-shot) due to RV→DR conversion: eliminating invalid relation names forces valid-but-mistyped mappings in high-$\bar{\kappa}$ schemas."

如果主文空间不够（≤8 页限制），可以简化为：
"Grammar-only decoding provides no independent DR benefit (SciERC: unchanged; DocRED: DR increases due to RV→DR conversion; see Appendix~\ref{app:70b-docred})."

**#2. Appendix DocRED ZS 消融表**

在 appendix_70b_ablation.tex 的 DocRED section 下面增加一个 ZS 消融子表或段落：

| Mode | DR% | RV% | ET% | CF | R-F1 | E-F1 |
|------|-----|-----|-----|-----|------|------|
| Unconstrained | 13.45 | 7.88 | 0 | 0 | 13.25 | 70.14 |
| Grammar-only | 17.03 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 13.23 | 70.12 |
| Semantic-only | 1.66 | 8.24 | 0.12 | 132 | 13.05 | 70.10 |

在表下写 2-3 句分析：
- Grammar-only：RV 7.88%→0% 但 DR 13.45%→17.03%（+3.58pp），RV→DR 转化效应。高 κ̄ (0.842) 意味着每个关系仅 ~16% type pair 合法，grammar 的 forced mapping 几乎必然产生新 DR。
- Semantic-only：DR 87.7% reduction（13.45%→1.66%），R-F1 不变。跨数据集一致（SciERC 84%）。
- 两层联合（full S1）结果待补入。

编译确认后回复。这次不用验证引用。

content.text:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - **EMNLP 2026 ARR paper submission by May 25** (DDL ~48 hours from current session time, 2026-05-23)
   - Continue from previous session: maximize paper quality before DDL
   - Complete 70B LoRA ablation experiments (SciERC + DocRED), write results into paper
   - Fix all remaining R19 review issues (writing fixes)
   - Keep all GPUs busy at all times ("不要让卡空闲")
   - Final compile and submit for R20 internal review before EMNLP submission
   - User (游承松) is aggressive about scope expansion and anti-conservative — wants strongest possible claims

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **OntoCoDec**: Two-layer constrained decoding framework (grammar via XGrammar + semantic via TypeConstraintProcessor) for LLM-based IE
   - **Scale-dependent enabling dependency**: At 8B both layers synergistic; at 70B semantic layer achieves 84% DR reduction independently, grammar layer provides zero (SciERC) or negative (DocRED) contribution
   - **RV→DR conversion effect**: Grammar-only on DocRED ZS converts RV violations to DR violations (13.45%→17.03%) due to forced mapping in high-κ̄ schemas
   - **S2 over-constraining at 70B**: R-F1 drops 8.45pp (44.73→36.28) due to Pass 1 entity under-extraction (-14.7%) cascading to Pass 2 relation loss
   - **Beam4 parse failure recovery confound**: DocRED +4.19pp beam boost primarily from recovering 24 parse-failed documents (12.5%→0.5%), not beam ranking quality. SciERC pure boost = +0.28pp
   - **Semantic layer scales with model capability**: 24% (8B ZS) → 84% (70B ZS) → 89% (70B ZS DocRED) independent DR reduction
   - **CF ≤1.4% bound**: Verified across all 8B FT configs, max=1.33% (70B LoRA SciERC S1, 15/1129)

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **review_issues.yaml** (`artifacts/review_issues.yaml`)
     - Central issue tracker across review rounds
     - Multiple batch updates: R17-W3, R19-W1/W2/W3/W4, R19-M1 → resolved; R16-W5, R16-MF3, R16-W1 → resolved after Paper Agent fixes
     - Remaining open: R16-W3 (WikiEvents n=20 power), R16-W4 (AWQ quantization), R19-M2, R18-M1, R18-M2 (all info-level)
   
   - **abstract.tex**
     - CF: "under fine-tuning, CF remains ≤1.4% with greedy decoding and reaches zero with beam search (k=4) on both RE datasets"
     - R-F1 range: "41--47%"
     - 70B: "70B-class validation on SciERC (full six-way ablation; §5.4) with preliminary DocRED support"
     - κ̄: kept as "descriptive correlate" with "(n=3, p=0.138)"

   - **section1_introduction_draft.tex**
     - R-F1 range: unified to "41--47%" (was "40--46%" at line 9)
     - 70B: "with 70B validation (full SciERC ablation, preliminary DocRED)"

   - **section5_runtime.tex**
     - Model name: "Llama-3.3-70B" → "Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct (AWQ INT4)"
     - Beam4 DocRED: "beam search additionally reduces parse failures from 12.5% to 0.5%, contributing to a +4.19pp R-F1 improvement; the controlled comparison on SciERC (0% parse failure in both settings) isolates the pure beam quality gain at +0.28pp"
     - Beam cross-scale: "70B beam4 confirms scale-independent violation elimination (DR=0% on both datasets at both 8B and 70B)"
     - Semantic scaling: "Semantic layer effectiveness scales with model capability (24%→84% independent DR reduction from 8B to 70B)"
     - §5.5 title: removed "Preliminary" from "70B-class validation"

   - **section7_conclusion_compressed.tex**
     - Added PICARD vs OntoCoDec distinction: "unlike rejection-based approaches that prune invalid outputs post-generation, the semantic layer applies constructive forward masking via a dynamic entity registry"
     - Positioned as "systematic empirical framework rather than a novel decoding algorithm"
     - Future work: "extending to global entity-level type consensus during decoding is the most important direction"

   - **appendix_70b_ablation.tex**
     - Model name: "Qwen2.5-72B-AWQ" → "Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct (AWQ INT4)"
     - SciERC LoRA table (tab:70b-ft-ablation): 6 rows (Unc/Grammar/Semantic/S1/S2/Beam4)
     - DocRED LoRA table (tab:70b-docred-ablation): 3 rows filled (Unc/S1/Beam4), grammar_only and semantic_only omitted with caption note
     - DocRED ZS table (tab:70b-docred-zs-ablation): 3 rows (Unc/Grammar/Semantic)
     - S2 CF反升 note: "S2 increases CF from 15 (S1) to 18 despite its cross-field consistency design, suggesting that over-constraining induces cascading generation degradation"
     - Grammar DR反升 analysis: RV→DR conversion mechanism in high-κ̄ schemas
     - Parse failure footnote on DocRED beam4 table

   - **Limitations section (main.tex)**
     - S2 degradation: "The two-pass strategy (S2) exhibits scale-dependent degradation: at 70B, S2 reduces R-F1 by 8.45pp while 8B models show comparable S1/S2 performance"
     - κ̄: changed "dual-factor pattern" → "observed relationship between schema restrictiveness and enforcement difficulty (n=3)"

   - **checklist.tex**
     - Deduplicated "Llama-3.3-70B, Llama-3.1-70B" → "Llama-3.1-70B"

   - **section4_composition_draft.tex** (previous session, carried over)
     - κ̄ "descriptive correlate" with "(n=3, p=0.138)"
   
   - **section5_docred_draft.tex**
     - §5.2: κ̄ reference removed, replaced with mechanism explanation "reflects DocRED's tighter constraints"

4. Errors and Fixes:
   - **Agent empty replies (recurring)**: Agent returned empty responses ~5 times throughout session. Attempted fixes: replace_agent_queue with simpler commands, urgent_agent_message with minimal instructions. Sometimes Agent responded after retry, sometimes needed multiple attempts. Likely a session stability issue.
   - **Model name critical error**: appendix wrote "Qwen2.5-72B-AWQ" for Llama-3.1-70B experiments. Fixed by Paper Agent — global search/replace across 3 files.
   - **R-F1 range internal contradiction**: Intro line 9 had "40-46%" while everywhere else had "41-47%". Fixed by unifying to "41-47%".
   - **Grammar "zero DR" misleading claim**: Main text said "grammar provides zero DR reduction" based on SciERC, but DocRED showed DR *increases* 3.58pp. Fixed by changing to "provides no independent DR benefit" with cross-reference to DocRED data.
   - **DocRED DR rate discrepancy**: paper_framing.md said 18.7%, Intro said 18.5%. Confirmed 18.5% = 18.46% rounded, consistent with tables. framing's 18.7% from deprecated version.
   - **Appendix placeholder "---"**: DocRED LoRA table had 7 "---" for data already in registry. Filled unconstrained and S1 rows from existing data.
   - **paper_compile_and_check "FAIL: 39 > 8"**: False positive — tool counts total pages including appendix. EMNLP allows unlimited appendix. Main text confirmed ≤ 8 pages.
   - **check_paper_consistency wrong directory**: First run used docs/paper (wrong), re-ran with artifacts/_project/paper (correct). Found 67 "critical" missing_bib_key warnings — these are tool artifacts because it only checks new_citations.bib, not the main bib files. Actual compilation shows 0 undefined citations.

5. Problem Solving:
   - **SOLVED: All R19 writing fixes** — CF optimism, κ̄ over-citation, novelty positioning all resolved
   - **SOLVED: 70B LoRA SciERC 5-way ablation** — Complete data, written to appendix
   - **SOLVED: S2 over-constraining diagnosis** — Confirmed by-design (pipeline error propagation), not bug
   - **SOLVED: Model name inconsistencies** — Unified to "Llama-3.1-70B" everywhere
   - **SOLVED: R-F1 range contradiction** — Unified to "41-47%"
   - **SOLVED: Grammar DR measure misleading** — Updated to reflect DocRED adverse effect
   - **SOLVED: 3 claim upgrades** — 70B preliminary→layered, beam cross-scale, semantic scaling
   - **SOLVED: DocRED beam4 parse failure confound** — Proper caveat in §5.5 and appendix
   - **PARTIALLY SOLVED: DocRED 70B ablation** — ZS 3/4 done (unc/grammar/semantic), LoRA 3/5 done (unc/S1/beam4), remaining experiments still running
   - **ONGOING: Agent empty replies** — Session instability, workaround is retrying with simpler commands
   - **ONGOING: DocRED LoRA semantic/grammar-only results** — Should be complete (~85% when last checked 30+ min ago) but Agent hasn't successfully reported

6. All User Messages:
   - "Continue from where you left off." (initial session start from context summary)
   - "[Agent 回复]:" (empty reply)
   - "Continue from where you left off." (multiple times — standard continuation prompts)
   - "[Agent 回复]: grammar_only conclusion 已修正为 negative。Worker 正在处理剩余任务。"
   - "[Paper Agent 回复]: [写作进展] R19 Writing Fixes (3/3) — 全部完成" (CF/κ̄/novelty fixes)
   - "[Reviewer 回复]: 审查报告 — 70B LoRA SciERC 消融批次完成" (S2 CF反升 warning, grammar-only info, semantic-only pass)
   - "[Agent 回复]: [资源] GPU 4/4 占用... 70B LoRA SciERC 五路消融完整表" (full 5-way results)
   - "[Paper Agent 回复]: 70B LoRA SciERC 五路消融写入完成"
   - "[Paper Agent 回复]: Patch 修正完成 — DocRED beam4 parse failure caveat"
   - "[Reviewer 回复]: 70B LoRA SciERC Paper Implications" (model name critical error found)
   - "[Paper Agent 回复]: 模型名称 Critical 修复完成"
   - "[Agent 回复]: S2 CF/R-F1 诊断结果 — 确认 over-constraining，非 bug"
   - "[Agent 回复]: [资源] GPU 4/4... DocRED beam4 48.14 结果"
   - "[Reviewer 回复]: 70B LoRA DocRED Beam4 S1 Paper Claim 评估" (+4.19pp confounded by parse failure recovery)
   - "[Paper Agent 回复]: Patch 完成 — 3 个 claim 升级"
   - "[Paper Agent 回复]: R-F1 范围修正 41--46 → 41--47"
   - "[Agent 回复]: [资源] GPU 4/4... ZS semantic-only complete, DocRED消融进度"
   - "[Reviewer 回复]: 70B ZS DocRED Semantic-Only 审查 + 实验状态"
   - "[Reviewer 回复]: Claim Strength Audit — Top 3 suggestions" (preliminary→layered, beam cross-scale, semantic scaling)
   - "[Reviewer 回复]: Final Pre-Submission Audit" (R-F1 range contradiction, appendix placeholders, CF bound verified, bib OK)
   - "[Paper Agent 回复]: 2 criticals修复 + placeholder填入"
   - "[Agent 回复]: [资源] GPU 4/4... DocRED ZS grammar_only DR反升 17.03%"
   - "[Reviewer 回复]: Grammar-only DR反升 analysis + RV→DR conversion mechanism"
   - "[Paper Agent 回复]: grammar措辞矛盾修复 + ZS DocRED消融写入"
   - "[Agent 回复]:" (empty, multiple times)
   - "[Agent 回复]: Worker 仍在运行（turn 19），正在跑 violation_checker"
   - Multiple "⏰ [System → Director]" keepalive nudges — responded with ACK/WAIT
   - "[Paper Agent 回复]: Patch确认 — grammar措辞+ZS DocRED（重复指令，ET更正为0.12%）"

7. Pending Tasks:
   - **Collect DocRED 70B LoRA semantic-only and grammar-only results** — experiments should be complete but Agent has failed to report (empty replies)
   - **Fill DocRED LoRA ablation table** — add grammar-only and semantic-only rows once results arrive
   - **Collect remaining experiments** — ZS full S1 and LoRA S2 on westd-21461 (~1-2h remaining)
   - **Final compilation** — paper_compile_and_check passed (39 pages, 0 critical warnings, main ≤ 8 pages)
   - **Submit R20 internal review** — submit_paper_to_review once all data patched in
   - **Fill idle GPUs** — westd-16980 likely has 2 idle GPUs after LoRA experiments completed
   - **Reviewer final pre-submission audit** — dispatched but response not yet received in this session
